name: kidane-mehret-live
description: Local livestream controls for Kidane Mehret Church

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @kidane/shared && concurrently -k -n contracts,agent,dashboard "npm run dev -w @kidane/shared" "npm run dev -w @kidane/agent" "npm run dev -w @kidane/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kidane/shared && npm run build -w @kidane/agent && npm run build -w @kidane/dashboard
